usage: Use 設計師 for someone whose job is designing things, like graphics, products, fashion, interiors, or websites.
It is a very natural and common job title in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese; you can use it on its own or with modifiers such as 平面、室內、網頁.
For a person, the usual pattern is「X係設計師」or「做設計師」; it is not normally used for the act of designing itself.
It sounds neutral and professional, suitable for work, profiles, introductions, and talking about careers.
